ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle, with points B, E, and D all marked on the circumference; a chord is drawn between E and D, and B is also on the circumference, so BE determined by endpoints B and E and ED determined by endpoints E and D are both chords in the same circle. Reasoning: The problem gives \overline{BE} \cong \overline{ED}, that is, chord BE and chord ED are congruent. In the same circle, the arcs intercepted by congruent chords are also congruent, so m\widehat{BE} = m\widehat{ED}. It is known that m\widehat{ED} = 120, therefore m\widehat{BE} = 120.

raw_record.question_text: If $\overline{B E} \cong \overline{E D}$ and $m\widehat{E D}=120,$ find $m\widehat{B E}$

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a circle with points B, E, and D on the circumference. From the text, use the given chord congruence \(\overline{BE}\cong\overline{ED}\) and the given arc measure \(m\widehat{ED}=120\). Apply the circle theorem: congruent chords in the same circle intercept congruent arcs. Therefore \(m\widehat{BE}=m\widehat{ED}=120\).
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个圆，点 B、E、D 都标在圆周上；E 和 D 之间画有弦，B 也在圆周上，因此由端点 B、E 确定的 BE 以及由端点 E、D 确定的 ED 都是同一圆中的弦。

推理：题目给出 \overline{BE} \cong \overline{ED}，即弦 BE 与弦 ED 全等。同一圆中，全等弦所截得的弧也全等，所以 m\widehat{BE} = m\widehat{ED}。已知 m\widehat{ED} = 120，因此 m\widehat{BE} = 120。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at N with B, E, and D on the circle. Consider radii \(NB\), \(NE\), and \(ND\). Since all radii of the same circle are congruent, \(NB=ND\) and \(NE\) is common when comparing triangles \(\triangle BNE\) and \(\triangle DNE\). The text gives \(BE=ED\). Thus the two triangles are congruent by SSS, so their central angles \(\angle BNE\) and \(\angle END\) are congruent. Congruent central angles intercept congruent arcs, so \(m\widehat{BE}=m\widehat{ED}=120\).
method.CoT_raw: 图像显示一个以 N 为圆心的圆，B、E、D 都在圆周上，且图中标出了从圆心 N 到圆周点的半径线段，如 NB、ND；E 也是圆周上的点，所以 NE 是同一圆的半径。题目给出 BE ≅ ED，且 m⌒ED = 120。因为 NB、NE、ND 都是同一个圆的半径，所以 NB = ND，且 NE 是三角形 BNE 和 DNE 的公共边。再加上给定的 BE = ED，所以 △BNE ≅ △DNE（SSS）。因此对应的圆心角 ∠BNE 与 ∠END 相等。相等的圆心角截得相等的弧，所以 m⌒BE = m⌒ED = 120。
